name: Trade
description: Moves real gold or goods: a merchant sells a ware the player asks to buy by name with offer_trade, at the shop price unless another was agreed (Barter only opens the shop menu to browse); a stranger pays only for what the player handed over first.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - World and Advanced Actions on in Mantella (it names the amount or the item). Followers, friends and lovers give and take freely; a stranger hands over gold or goods only as payment for what you handed them in the same talk. Anything you hand over asks you Yes/No first. offer_trade is for merchants only.

kind.description: give_*: you hand over what you carry; ask_*: the player hands it to you; offer_trade: a merchant sells a ware asked for from the shop; take_gift: opens the gift menu.

item.description: Item name, for the item kinds.

price.description: offer_trade: the agreed gold for all of it; leave out for the shop price.

prompt: When the player wants to give you something, begin your response with '{key}:'
